"""

import argparse
import json
import logging

import sys

)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)



def concatenate_benchmarks(data, exposure_scores, benchmarks=None,
                           exclude_rules=None, max_items=None, seed=42):
    """Concatenate all benchmark data into a single response/exposure matrix.

    Args:
        data: output of load_eval_results
        exposure_scores: per-benchmark tau vectors
        benchmarks: subset of benchmarks to include (None=all)
        exclude_rules: list of dicts {"model", "benchmark", "reason"}.

    dosages = data["dosages"]

    bench_names = benchmarks or list(data["benchmarks"].keys())

    excluded_benchmarks = set()
    if exclude_rules:
        model_names = [m["model_name"] for m in models]
        for rule in exclude_rules:
            rule_model = rule.get("model", "")
            rule_bench = rule.get("benchmark", "")
            if any(rule_model in mn for mn in model_names):
                excluded_benchmarks.add(rule_bench.lower())
                log.info("Exclude rule: skipping benchmark %s (model=%s, reason=%s)",
                         rule_bench, rule_model, rule.get("reason", "n/a"))

    all_y = []
    all_exposure = []
    slices = {}
    col_offset = 0
    all_valid = []

    for bench in bench_names:
        if bench not in data["benchmarks"]:
            continue
        if bench.lower() in excluded_benchmarks:
            continue
        bd = data["benchmarks"][bench]
        responses = bd["responses"]
        valid = bd["valid_mask"]
        all_valid.append(valid)
        tau = exposure_scores[bench]
        n_items = bd["n_items"]

        if not valid.all():
            responses_valid = responses[valid]
            dosages_valid = dosages[valid]
        else:
            responses_valid = responses
            dosages_valid = dosages

        exposure_matrix = build_exposure_matrix(dosages_valid, tau[:n_items])

        # D023 + Reviewer: random subsampling per benchmark (not truncation)
        if max_items and n_items > max_items:
            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
            idx = np.sort(rng.choice(n_items, max_items, replace=False))
            responses_valid = responses_valid[:, idx]
            exposure_matrix = exposure_matrix[:, idx]
            log.info("Joint fit: %s subsampled %d -> %d items (seed=%d)",
                     bench, n_items, max_items, seed)
            n_items = max_items

        all_y.append(responses_valid)
        all_exposure.append(exposure_matrix)
        slices[bench] = (col_offset, col_offset + n_items)
        col_offset += n_items

            assert np.array_equal(v, all_valid[0]), \
                "valid model masks differ across benchmarks \u2014 cannot concatenate safely"

    y_concat = np.concatenate(all_y, axis=1)
    exp_concat = np.concatenate(all_exposure, axis=1)

    return {
        "y": y_concat,
        "exposure": exp_concat,
        "dosages": dosages,
        "benchmark_slices": slices,
        "n_total_items": col_offset,
    }

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if pool_scales:
        data = load_pooled_eval_results(eval_dir, pool_scales, benchmarks,
                                         seed_filter=seed_filter,
                                         aligned_only=aligned_only)
    else:
        data = load_eval_results(eval_dir, benchmarks,

                                  seed_filter=seed_filter,

                                    max_items=max_items, seed=seed)

    exposure = concat["exposure"]
    log.info("Joint fit: %d models x %d total items", y.shape[0], y.shape[1])
    log.info("Benchmark slices: %s", concat["benchmark_slices"])

        chains=chains, iter_warmup=warmup, iter_sampling=samples,

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Pooled IRT (N>=16) across 3 scales × 4 dosages × 2 seeds
# Benchmarks: ARC + GSM8K, S1-only exposure, MCMC warmup=2000 samples=2000

EVAL_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/eval_results"
CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints"
SIGNALS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals"
OUTPUT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/exp006/results_pooled_n16"
EXP006_DIR="/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp006"
MIN_N=16

SCALES=("0.5B" "1.5B" "3B")
DOSAGES=("000" "005" "025" "100")
SEEDS=("42" "123")
BENCHMARKS=("arc_challenge" "gsm8k")

DRY_RUN=""
FORCE_ORACLE=0
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --dry-run) DRY_RUN="--dry-run" ;;
        --oracle)  FORCE_ORACLE=1 ;;
    esac
done

echo "============================================"
echo "  Pooled IRT N>=${MIN_N} — Prerequisite Check"
echo "============================================"
echo ""

# Phase 1: Check aligned eval availability
MISSING_EVAL=()
MISSING_SFT=()
FOUND=0

for scale in "${SCALES[@]}"; do
    for dose in "${DOSAGES[@]}"; do
        for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
            tag="${scale} d${dose} s${seed}"
            # 3B s42 uses v2 to avoid LoRA-damaged v1 data
            if [[ "$scale" == "3B" && "$seed" == "42" ]]; then
                eval_path="${EVAL_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_v2_s${seed}_aligned"
                ckpt_path="${CKPT_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_v2_s${seed}"
            else
                eval_path="${EVAL_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_s${seed}_aligned"
                ckpt_path="${CKPT_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_s${seed}"
            fi

            if [ -f "${eval_path}/eval_results.json" ]; then
                printf "  ✓ %-22s eval DONE\n" "$tag"
                FOUND=$((FOUND + 1))
            elif [ -d "${ckpt_path}/lora_adapter" ]; then
                printf "  ✗ %-22s SFT done, eval MISSING\n" "$tag"
                MISSING_EVAL+=("$tag")
            else
                printf "  ✗ %-22s SFT MISSING\n" "$tag"
                MISSING_SFT+=("$tag")
            fi
        done
    done
done

echo ""
echo "── Summary ──"
echo "Aligned evals complete: ${FOUND}/24"
echo "SFT done, eval needed:  ${#MISSING_EVAL[@]}"
echo "SFT missing:            ${#MISSING_SFT[@]}"
echo ""

if [ ${FOUND} -lt ${MIN_N} ]; then
    echo "ERROR: N=${FOUND} < ${MIN_N}. Cannot run pooled IRT."
    echo ""
    if [ ${#MISSING_EVAL[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Quick wins (SFT done, just run aligned eval):"
        for m in "${MISSING_EVAL[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $m"
        done
    fi
    if [ ${#MISSING_SFT[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "Need SFT + eval:"
        for m in "${MISSING_SFT[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $m"
        done
    fi
    exit 1
fi

# Phase 2: Check S1 signal coverage
echo "=== Signal Coverage (S1 exposure) ==="
SIG_OK=0
SIG_MISSING=0
SIG_MISSING_LIST=()

for scale in "${SCALES[@]}"; do
    for dose in "${DOSAGES[@]}"; do
        for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
            if [[ "$scale" == "3B" && "$seed" == "42" ]]; then
                eval_path="${EVAL_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_v2_s${seed}_aligned"
                sig_dir="${SIGNALS_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_v2_s${seed}"
            else
                eval_path="${EVAL_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_s${seed}_aligned"
                sig_dir="${SIGNALS_DIR}/Qwen2.5-${scale}_d${dose}_s${seed}"
            fi
            [ -f "${eval_path}/eval_results.json" ] || continue
            all_ok=1
            for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
                if [ ! -f "${sig_dir}/signals_merged_${bench}.json" ]; then
                    all_ok=0
                fi
            done
            if [ $all_ok -eq 1 ]; then
                SIG_OK=$((SIG_OK + 1))
            else
                SIG_MISSING=$((SIG_MISSING + 1))
                SIG_MISSING_LIST+=("${scale}_d${dose}_s${seed}")
            fi
        done
    done
done

echo "Models with S1 signals: ${SIG_OK}/${FOUND}"
echo "Models without signals: ${SIG_MISSING}"

if [ ${SIG_MISSING} -gt 0 ] && [ ${FORCE_ORACLE} -eq 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "WARNING: S1 signals incomplete. Models without signals:"
    for m in "${SIG_MISSING_LIST[@]}"; do
        echo "  - $m"
    done
    echo ""
    echo "Falling back to --oracle-exposure (dosage-based)."
    echo "To force S1 signals (pooled mode will exclude uncovered scales),"
    echo "generate signals for missing models first."
    EXPOSURE_ARGS="--oracle-exposure"
elif [ ${FORCE_ORACLE} -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "Using oracle exposure (--oracle flag)."
    EXPOSURE_ARGS="--oracle-exposure"
else
    echo "All models have S1 signals. Using S1-only exposure."
    EXPOSURE_ARGS="--signals-dir ${SIGNALS_DIR} --signal-key s1_embedding"
fi

# Phase 3: Activate conda and run
echo ""
echo "=== Running Pooled IRT ==="
echo "Benchmarks: ${BENCHMARKS[*]}"
echo "MCMC: warmup=2000, samples=2000, chains=4"
echo "Output: ${OUTPUT_DIR}/"
echo ""

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

for bench in "${BENCHMARKS[@]}"; do
    echo "──── ${bench} ────"
    python "${EXP006_DIR}/run_exp006.py" \
        --eval-dir "${EVAL_DIR}" \
        --pool-scales 0.5B 1.5B 3B \
        --aligned-only \
        --benchmarks "${bench}" \
        ${EXPOSURE_ARGS} \
        --warmup 2000 \
        --samples 2000 \
        --output-dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${bench}" \
        ${DRY_RUN}
    echo ""
done

echo "=== Done. Results in ${OUTPUT_DIR}/ ==="
